episodes.synopsis: Izumi and her coworkers try to fulfill the request of a little girl, unaware of the resulting chain of events that leads them to lost memories and unimaginable treasures.
episodes.title: Welcome to the Rabbit Shed Shop

episodes.synopsis: Defeating the rogue virus requires transporting into the world of anime and manga! First stop is "Welcome to Rabbit Cafe" where rabbits are now nowhere to be found.
episodes.title: What to say to "May I Take Your Order?"

episodes.synopsis: Sales are down, so the employees must come up with a special event. But more importantly, the world of "The Rosy Maidens" has fallen victim to the virus!
episodes.title: We're the Rosy Maidens

episodes.synopsis: Komachi will not stand idly by while "Mini Basket" vanishes into obscurity. This time, however, fighting the viruses may not be enough.
episodes.title: Elementary School Kids are the Best!

episodes.synopsis: When all else fails, try shogi.
episodes.title: Here, Here, Here, Like That?

episodes.synopsis: Izumi tries to bond with Rei, but the conversation gets awkward. Rei tries to hide that she likes cute things, but what will she do when the virus starts affecting hamsters?
episodes.title: It's Not That I Like Hamsters...

episodes.synopsis: It's time to grind levels, because the viruses have taken the fight to "Quest of Phantasia"! Now all the girls need to do is figure a way past annoying video game mechanics.
episodes.title: Can Fighters Make Lots of Money?

episodes.synopsis: Nao needs to sharpen her kitchen knife and brush up on her culinary skills because it's time for all-out WAR against the viruses.
episodes.title: A Showdown! It's a Food Battle!

episodes.synopsis: Kaoruko enjoys dating sims, but she keeps getting all the bad endings! Looks like some training is in order.
episodes.title: Let's Become the Masters of Romance

episodes.synopsis: The main character has been defeated, but all hope is not yet lost -- He entrusted Ayaka with his sword. It is all up to her and her friends now.
episodes.title: Goodbye, Nejiusa...

episodes.synopsis: Despite the group's best effort, shops keep closing. However, they can't give up just yet! Preserving memories is far too important.
episodes.title: Is it true?! Final Battle in Akihabara!

episodes.synopsis: While the group searches for the whereabouts of Kaoruko and Komachi, Izumi, Ayaka and Irina come to a realization.
episodes.title: Pastel Memories
